limits_bridge.scope: Only INT_MAX/INT_MIN needed by extracted core, derived from target compiler predefined __INT_MAX__; GCC i386 hosted libc headers are unavailable.

limits: 1064 host timing samples in152 cells; exact finite outputs checked independently. No affinity/frequency control or confidence interval; other host tasks may interfere.
Uniform dictionary variants share semantics; alternating per-element policy variants form a separate comparison. Fixed-add measurements at selector1 must not be compared as a maximum operation.
Each representation benchmark uses1000 objects and100 rounds; direct typed storage, embedded tables and external views have explicitly different storage overhead. No universal layout ABI is inferred.
Warmth is uncontrolled. Cache observations count actual software hits/misses, not hardware cache events.

The initial GCC i386 build failed because installed hosted libc headers lacked bits/libc-header-start.h. This standalone probe supplies only the required INT_MAX/INT_MIN from compiler predefines, preserving the C arithmetic model; no libc-dependent program is claimed validated.
Linux i386 execution uses exact extracted original core functions and actual public types. It excludes dynamic loading, allocator and board/runtime components; no freestanding board execution claim.
Independent expected values are author-built models, not independent human assessment or learner mastery.
